context_for_next_testing_agent: Email field removed from AdminCreate and ValetCreate models. Backend auto-generates email as '{phone_stripped}@valetguys.local'. Frontend forms no longer show email input. All phone fields prefilled with '+91'. Push notifications use polling-based detection (toast + audio + browser notification) and optional Web Push via service worker.
